segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: our vision is to elevate local industries across nine key sectors,

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: creating world-class products designed to be sold locally and globally.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Importante ang global market, pero we also need to exhaust the strength of our local market.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: or foreign investors to our country.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we encourage them to export, but we also encourage them to sell locally.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Importante din for us to provide market access for them.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We have a lot of trade shows.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So from those trade shows, we invite now buyers, let's say, hotel buyers, cafe buyers, grocery, supermarkets,

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: institutional buyers, consolidators, and foreign buyers, actually, to all of these trade shows.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: And our trade show sales has grown leaps and bounds, including those that attend the trade shows.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Another thing that we encourage is the double income in a family.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: The DTI has also established the Women's Enterprise Fund.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Kasi in the Asian style, it's always the men that works and the women stays at home and takes care of the children.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So ang pinush namin ngayon is to encourage double income in a family.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we've set aside 2 billion pesos for Women's Enterprise Fund.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So they can do business sa bahay.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Or if they have existing businesses that they want to expand, they want to grow,

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Okay, when double income, napaka-importante ang double income in a family because we encourage...

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Because of this double income, there's better education, better quality of life.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: They can eat out or they can also mag-vacate.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: which will also provide the jobs.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: And this will also strengthen the local tourism.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we need to encourage double income in the family.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So importante din ito because we really want to push na dito sila.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We want a better life for our Filipino people.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we need to strengthen the small and medium.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We need to strengthen the enterprises and we need to strengthen also yung market access for them.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: In 2025, our nationwide efforts to expand market access, in spite of our budget,

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: we needed to achieve exceptional results and we needed to be strategic in our moves.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Hindi siya pwedeng, we just move without strategizing.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we expanded our reach by organizing a total of 33 trade fairs across NDA.

segments.text: But we can grow more if we increase our budget.

segments.text: The more market access or the more avenues we have for them to showcase their products,

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: and they can also level up the jobs and also help the community.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We generated a combined sales of our trade show nasa 1.0.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: But we are providing wider market access to more than 3,500 MSME's across the country.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So lahat ng mga MSME's or SME's that want to join the DTI's trade fair nationwide, libre po ito.

segments.text: The DTI works closely also with institutions such as SM, Robinsons, and other big corporations to actually showcase their products.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque

segments.text: But we need to be strategic again in our moves.

segments.text: Beyond providing market access through the trade fairs,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: We fully welcome this opportunity to be able to provide

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: particularly because, ang dami nga ho, kagaya ng sinabi ninyo, Representative Cendaña,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: ang dami ng mga lumalabas na balita.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: But first of all, talagang we welcome this opportunity

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: and we welcome all of the comments,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo

segments.text: negative or positive, because it can only

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: make the policy direction better pagka ho

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So we really welcome this opportunity.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Banggitin ko lang ho na lahat ho ng mga dokumento

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So, pinost na ho natin iyan doon in the spirit of transparency din ho para makita na rin ho ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.text: Meron din ho tayong mga short video clips about what Pax Silica is at ano po yung project doon sa New Clark City. Unfortunately lang ho, kaunti lang ang mga nanonood. As of this time, I think as of last week,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: We can provide a copy, Honorable Chair.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: And second ho, it's very important to distinguish between the partnership and the project.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kasi nagkakalituhan talaga, pag pinag-usapan yung Pax Silica, akala nila iyon na yung ginagawa ho natin sa New Clark City, iyon na ho yung buong Pax Silica.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Pero we have to distinguish between the partnership and the project.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Pax Silica as a partnership is actually a non-binding statement or declaration that we have signed on to together with now 23 other countries and an economy.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: It is really for securing the supply chain for your AI tech ecosystem.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kung halimbawa, ang sinasabi ho nila dito ay, if the past century was run on oil and on steel, this new century will be run on compute capacity.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: And it is about securing the entire supply chain from mining, minerals, to advanced manufacturing, to data centers.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: To the software that take advantage of this compute capacity.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So the whole supply chain po yun.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ang pagdating ko dito sa atin pong project, yung New Clark City po is just one of the projects na pinupush ho ng Pilipinas at saka isang partner country doon sa Pax Silica.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: It is just one of the project.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: And this project will really be focused on advanced manufacturing.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Agam-agam sa mga concern, we fully understand the concerns.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: And lahat naman po ng mga sinasabi ng mga stakeholders natin, tama naman po.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kaya lang po, yung assumption, halimbawa po tungkol sa kakain ng napakalaking power at tubig, yung mga AI data centers, tama naman po na kumakain talaga sila ng power and water.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ang mali lang po ay hindi po iyon yung gagawin sa New Clark City.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ang gagawin po sa New Clark City is really for advanced manufacturing.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So this would be for the equipment that will go into the AI data centers.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: But the AI data centers themselves will not be in the New Clark City.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Be that as it may, kahit ganun po, alam din naman po natin na advanced manufacturing kumakain pa rin po ng power, kumakain pa rin po ng water.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Just like any other export and manufacturing zones do.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ang usapan naman po natin dito.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ang basic condition po doon sa mag-develop po ng New Clark City.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: And ito, hindi sa [unclear] ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: That you have to build your own roads, bring your own power, and then secure and reuse your own water.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So yun po ang usapan natin doon sa mag-develop doon sa New Clark City.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: And isang project lang po yun.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Meron po yung whole stack ng AI po.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Mag-uusap pa ho tayo ng ibang

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Possible locations for those other areas.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Halimbawa po, pag pinag-usapan natin data center.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: It may happen in another location na mas appropriate for data center.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, mas available yung tubig at mas available yung power.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: But again, build your own power, secure your own water, secure and reuse your own water, build your own roads.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Halimbawa po, just last week, kausap po natin isang locality, isang LGU dito sa Manila.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ang pinag-uusapan naman po natin is an IC Design National Hub.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Pero pinag-uusapan na natin yun sa isang LGU dito sa Manila na meron na po silang 13 IC Design companies,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: four of which are Filipino companies.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: At meron silang kolehyo doon na ginagastusan din ng LGU na nakafocus sa microelectronics.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Very important for the IC design industry.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: And ang kausap po natin na partner na tutulong dito sa IC Design Hub po natin ay hindi ang U.S.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: But another partner which is within the Pax Silica partnership.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So iyon ho, iba ho yung partnership, iba yung mga project.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: New Clark City is just one of the projects and it will be focused on the advanced manufacturing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, thank you, Yusek Rodolfo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Medyo hindi po na-assuage yung fears ng ating mga kababayan sa inyo pong sagot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: In fact, sa halip na ma-assuage yung fears, medyo mas naalarma tayo knowing na multiple sites pala ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, may we direct the DTI to kindly submit to the committee the prospective sites for the other projects under the Pax Silica agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po nakaka-bother yung usapin ng use of resources.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Medyo mahirap pong sabihin na bring your own water and electricity kasi alam naman po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa atin pong water table iyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So, hindi po infinite ang ating tubig.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Finite po yan at kailangan po yan ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Let me now go to a discussion on the concerns of the communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nakonsulta po ba ang mga community? Kasi napakahalaga po sa atin ang free prior and informed consent?

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: For the New Clark City project po, based doon sa binanggit na rin po publicly ni BCDA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, before entering into the agreement, hindi po nagkaroon ng consultation.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: On the specific project po sa Clark, the New Clark City is an existing master-planned industrial zone.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Tapos ho, on the specific na within that industrial zone,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: na to. And it's a work in progress,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: by the way, on that new Clark City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, may we direct the DTI

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: pong lupang ninuno. Kaya nga po

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: on the ground when it comes to the implementation

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: of this project. Let me move on

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: and this is on the issue of the

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: good Secretary. Nagsimula na po ang negosasyon, pipirmahan na po ito pagdating ng Nobyembre.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ang tanong po ng mga concerned sectors, particularly po mga kasamahan natin mula sa SENTRO, isang labor center,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: would the DTI commit to making the negotiated texts available to Congress and the public before the agreement is signed

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: so that the implications can be properly reviewed and scrutinized?

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Yes, Honorable Congressman. Yes, Madam Chair. Yes,

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We will make it available for everyone, and ibibigay din namin sa kanila what are the advantages of this DEFA

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: and what the businesses or the industries can gain from this DEFA.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Kasi actually, this is very important kasi we're now in the digital space, digital economy na po tayo.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we need to be able to adapt to the changes of the times and napakaimportante ng

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: And then kasali rin dito yung AI.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we will give a complete and a comprehensive information on this DEFA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Hihintayin po namin yung details of the agreement at sana po ma-submit before tayo magplenaryo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Let me move on to the RACE program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Idinulog po ito ng mga kasama natin mula sa Philippine Metalworkers Alliance, or PMA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasi po doon sa budget ng 2026, ang na-veto na item ay para sana sa restoring the RACE program ng DTI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ang tanong po natin ay ano po ang mangyayari dito sa RACE program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ito po ba'y itutuloy pang pondohan ng gobyerno?

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Madam Chair and Honorable Congressman, yes, matutuloy itong RACE program because marami pa ring combustion vehicles that are being produced here in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we're just finishing some of the final touches of this program.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We're just getting the budget also from the DBM for this.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So once completed po ito, we will again inform the public, just like when we had the EVs and all other programs po ng DTI.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Ini-inform po namin talaga yung public para alam nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, may we request DTI to submit to this committee?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: the details of their proposed budget for the RACE program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Under the Electric Vehicle Industry Development Act, or EVIDA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: under the DOE po itong programa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: at may sarili din pong electric vehicle program, EVIS naman,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: po kaya na isa na lang yung EVIS at RACE or any other program sa automotive sector

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: ay sa isang ahensya na lang po ng gobyerno ilagay

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: para hindi po silo. Sayang po yung resources lalo na kung may duplication ng trabaho?

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We will be coordinating closely. But for the EVs, kasi this is the incentive scheme for those companies that want to manufacture electric vehicles in the country, whether hybrid plus electric or pure electric po. So again, we will give you the complete information on this for both RACE and for EVs also. Thank you, Honorable Congressman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Secretary. Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: may we ask the DTI kung meron po ba tayong industrial policy

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: which will serve as a roadmap para sa electric vehicle or automotive sector in particular?

segments.speaker: Rep. Charisse Anne C. Hernandez
segments.text: Can you repeat again the question?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ang tanong po ay meron po ba tayong industrial policy that could serve as a roadmap

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: para po sa electric vehicle or automotive sector sa ating bansa?

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Madam Chair, on the automotive industry po,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: our policy really is to shift towards the electric vehicle

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: as the main technology type for the sector po.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Except that hindi ho natin pwedeng pabayaan din,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: kagaya ng nasabi ninyo yung mga nasa metalworking sector ho natin.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: That's why meron tayong transition towards the full electric vehicle adoption.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Nabanggit na rin ho naman ni Presidente doon sa SONA niya yung adoption ng electric vehicle.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: may we request the DTI to submit to this committee

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: the said policy which will serve as a roadmap for the industry?

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Actually, from the CARS program, we shifted lang to the RACE program

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: to encourage more companies that want to build manufacturing for the combustion vehicles.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: That's why yung CARS program naging RACE program po ito.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: And then to adapt to the changing times also,

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: which is the electric vehicles now, both hybrid plus electric or total electric.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: to encourage more companies to invest in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair, Madam Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Punta na po ako dito sa usapin na mainit na mainit ngayon. Ito pong usapin ng union busting sa DHL.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: We know that DHL is a major partner of the DTI for MSME support and development.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: DHL Philippines is also a partner of the DTI Supply Chain and Logistics Center

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: and was part of the private sector group.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: convened by the SCLC for the centralization of logistics expertise and industry collaboration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nababahala po tayo kasi ang DHL po ngayon ay may kaso ng union busting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So ang tanong po ng lahat, how can DHL claim to be a socially responsible corporation

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: when it is openly violating the rights of workers in their Sukat warehouse?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: How can the Philippines tout DHL as a principled partner for inclusive,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: How can a union buster genuinely claim that it works for the interests of ordinary people,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: those that the MSMEs cater to and represent?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: In line with this, we would like to call the attention of the DTI Secretary on this matter

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: and urgently review its partnership with DHL Philippines in light of the current

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: problems faced by its workers. Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Charisse Anne C. Hernandez
segments.text: That will be your last question.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair and Honorable Congressman.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Actually, the Supply Chain and Logistics Department in DTI is just to actually share with our

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: businesses how they can use the logistics companies to move their products.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So I now can engage or can meet with all of these logistics companies to explore the different

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: costs that they can incur or that they will incur.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: When they move their products, kasi gusto natin ma-move yung mga products at the least possible

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So iyon po ang engagement ng DTI with DHL.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: But with your concerns po, we can work with the DOLE on this.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Ang importante na is to move the products, especially during calamity when we need to

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: move the food products to the different regions, especially that we are 7,600 islands,

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: with all of these logistics companies so

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: ng Supply Chain and Logistics Department namin sa DTI and the role of the logistics company once it comes

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: to the DTI. Doon po, to

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: encourage businesses po, to encourage rin, and to really make sure that the movements of the goods are

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: ng mga logistics companies na ito in terms of movements of the products po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Secretary. Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Paalala lamang po, i-review po natin yung agreements natin with this union buster, that is DHL. Marami pong salamat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Charisse Anne C. Hernandez
segments.text: Thank you, Cong. Perci. And again, may we remind the DTI to submit the documents requested

segments.speaker: Rep. Charisse Anne C. Hernandez
segments.text: so that the concerns of Representative Cendaña will be addressed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Charisse Anne C. Hernandez
segments.text: Next in line to ask from the majority is Representative Ando Oaminal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. Good morning, Secretary, and to the members of the DTI family, and to our distinguished Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Madam Chair, this representation received some reports on alleged irregularities

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: and alleged unlawful practices being observed by the department, particularly in the procurement division.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And so I wrote a letter to the good secretary as part of this representation's oversight functions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And when I received and reviewed the documents forwarded to my office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: some of the claims are valid.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So in particular, I wrote about the procurement of several vehicles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And I have several documents here, but I would like to focus first on the procurement with bidding number 24.057.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: May staffa sa copy kung sino po yung sasagot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yung BAC chairperson po ay si...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Christian Ablan, and the HoPE is a certain attorney, Asec. Uvero.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: However, sa NTP, iba po yung nag-sign, hindi po yung HoPE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Sa contract agreement, iba po din yung nag-sign.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Si... ang BAC chairman ang nag-sign.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, may we know under what authorities, bakit nagkakaiba-iba po yung HoPE for each transaction?

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Honorable Chair, I'll defer to Chris Ablan so he can respond to your queries and issues.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: Madam Chair, thank you very much.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: I am currently the BAC chair of the DTI Bids and Awards Committee.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: We will look into the PR of this.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: But as a matter of practice, and following the rules, the BAC chair does not sign a notice to proceed.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: And in the case of then-HoPE Asec. Uvero, there may have been a transfer since Asec. Uvero transferred to the Bureau of Customs.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: And so, we will look into this PR and submit to the committee clarifications on what was mentioned by the good congressman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Usec, andiyan naman po, finorward sa inyo yung copy ng documents that came from your office.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, can you please check the contract agreement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Isn't it your signature on that document?

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: For this particular PR, the Bids and Awards Committee head was not yet this person, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: It was still Usec Boy Vismonte.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: But you were the one who signed the BAC resolution for this transaction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: You signed the BAC resolution and you signed the contract agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: You signed the BAC resolution as the BAC chairperson, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: The document given to me by your staff is dated 2023.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: I wasn't yet with the DTI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Nandiyan po yung document, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: I just confirmed for BAC Resolution 280, series of 2024, procurement of vehicles from Toyota Pasong Tamo.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: I signed as the chair of the Bids and Awards Committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: What document are you talking about?

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: You're talking about the BAC resolution, Mr. Chair, right?

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: I'm talking about BAC Resolution 280, series of 2024.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: I signed as the chair of the BAC.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: And then approved by our head of procuring entity, then Asec. Uvero.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: And, Mr. Chair, did you also sign the contract agreement for that particular transaction?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, Mr. Chair, matanong ko lang po, bakit hindi po si HoPE ang nag-sign, and bakit po yung BAC chairperson ang nag-sign ng contract agreement?

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: We'll look into this, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: I think this was the time when there was a transition between Asec. Uvero and the new HoPE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Section 11.2.5 of the 2016 Revised IRR of RA 9184 provides

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: that in no case shall the HoPE and/or the approving authority be the chairperson

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: or a member of the BAC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Do you agree with this, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: We'll look into this February 5, 2025 contract agreement and align it with our records of

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: who was the head of procuring entity.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: We'll clarify the committee, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: So, Mr. Chair, do you confirm that in this particular transaction, you violated Section 11.2.5 of RA 9184?

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I don't recall signing this particular document, but the signature shows my signature.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: So I'll verify with my records, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: What are you trying to imply, Mr. Chair, that you don't recall signing that document?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: That document came from the, no less than the Office of the Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Are you denying now that that document is a certified copy of the original?

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I would have to check my records.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: I do have photocopies of all the contracts and resolutions I signed, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Chair, granting that this is a real document, kasi galing po sa inyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: do you consider this a violation of Section

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: 11.2.5 of the 2016 Revised IRR of RA 9184,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: granting that this is a real document?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Kasi you are now questioning the validity of the document, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DTI BAC Chair Christian Ablan
segments.text: I have to check with my records, Mr. Chair, as to this document.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Mr. Chair, my question is, granting that this is a real document.

segments.speaker: Rep. Charisse Anne C. Hernandez
segments.text: Cong. Oaminal, while the Asec. is checking his documents, do you have other questions

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: I have other documents here, different procurement documents that have the same issues

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: involving different officers of the agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sancho Fernando "Ando" F. Oaminal
segments.text: Yung sa akin lang po kasi, of course, you are presenting your budget proposal

segments.text: and what specific programs will ensure that this fund reach our entrepreneurs on the ground.

segments.text: Mr. Chair, Nueva Ecija has a strong agricultural economy, but many of our farmers and small

segments.speaker: DTI halal-program respondent Bianca (functional attribution)

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula

segments.text: Oo nga po no, medyo nababaan. Medyo na-alarma ako.

segments.text: Actually, Honorable Congresswoman, we need more budget talaga for the halal considering na ang laking potential ng halal globally.

segments.text: So, actually nasa 3 trillion US dollars na po ang potential ng halal but we need to get our products certified

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: for the products to join more trade shows para mas makikilala yung mga produkto natin globally.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: But locally, we also see a growing population of Muslims in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We have more Muslims now than in UAE.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So, malaki din po yung potential ng halal products dito.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: But we need more budget actually for the certification and also for the slaughterhouse.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: And then to be able to produce the quality products or halal products that can compete globally.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: In the past, wala masyadong budget in the past 2 years.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: But for this year, nakikita natin that this is really a huge potential for export po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Na kinakailangan natin na palaguin pa ito dahil may potential nga naman itong halal industry na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At with that, I would like to...

segments.text: Particularly on the halal industry budget po nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I have another question, Madam Chair.

segments.text: Tulad po nang nabanggit ko kanina, for 2025, 277 na po ang natulungan natin.

segments.speaker: DTI halal-program respondent Bianca (functional attribution)
segments.text: For 2026, we were able to help 140 MSMEs to get their products halal certified.

segments.speaker: DTI halal-program respondent Bianca (functional attribution)
segments.text: Meron pa po tayong mga ongoing projects, specifically catering to export markets to get them halal certified.

segments.speaker: DTI halal-program respondent Bianca (functional attribution)
segments.text: We work directly po with recognized certifying bodies of these—

segments.speaker: DTI halal-program respondent Bianca (functional attribution)
segments.text: certifying bodies of our key export markets.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Good afternoon, Honorable Congressman. Actually, we did not expect also na bumaba yung budget because we have a lot of programs,

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: and there's also a lot of things that we need to do to be able to contribute to providing jobs and also to provide the industries with a push para at least makausa din sila.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So this is why we are here, to ask for additional budget for the three main mandates of DTI, which is investment promotion, consumer protection, and fair trade.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: And also the MSME development. So yun ang kailangan po natin.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Because we need to, the only way for us to be able to push also these programs is for us to be able to have the budget that we need.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Without this budget, then it will be difficult for us to also push the products that we need to export or that we need to sell locally.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: And then we also need to enforce and to make sure that the products that are being sold in the market pass through the standards of DTI.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: And we want to encourage more investors to come into the Philippines, but again, we also need budget to be able to promote this.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Even if our numbers are up, our exports are up, also our investments are up, but then there's also the Middle East crisis that also contributed to the challenge that we are facing now.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: But again, tuloy-tuloy pa rin ang mga programa ng DTI.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: To level up also the skills of the people, that's why we work very closely with TESDA on industries that are relevant nowadays or industries of the investors that are coming in.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Kasi actually, nung kausap namin yung mga investors, ang hinihingi nila, talent, talent, talent.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we need also the other departments to provide us with these talents.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: So we have a program with ADB, which we are...

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We are hoping to conclude already, which is ASCEND, which will train our people for higher-paying jobs.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Kasi now, we have jobs for people, but of course, the jobs are not high paying or jobs that we want them to achieve also, at least in the future.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Balikan ko lang yung, again, yung sinabi kanina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: klaro po yung sinabi nyo kanina na

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa implementation ng Paxilika, Philippine law will always prevail, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, hindi totoo yung sinasabing joint governance sa mga Paxilika projects.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Madam Chair, Philippine laws po yung mag-go-govern, but hindi...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nako, may bat. Bakit may bat?

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Nalimbawa po, si BCDA, meron siyang...

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Pinapalist na isang area dun sa New Clark City with Philinvest.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So, yung decision po, kung sino yung mga tatanggapin doon sa...

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: As a locator, would really be on the hands of nung nagde-develop na yun, like si Philinvest.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Like, kalimbawa po, sa Subic, sa SBMA, meron din pong Taiwanese company na nandun, si...

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So, siya po yung nagde-develop nung area.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: But, when they register po, they would be registering under the Export Development Act.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Yung locator, siya yung bahalang mag-invite.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Pwede rin po diyan yung mag-invite din.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Pero, yung registration po nila, terms and conditions, would all be under the BCDA law, tsaka dun sa Export Development Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In the case of New Clark City,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: that 1,600 hectare area, ibigay sa U.S. company, tapos sila ang bahala mag-invite ng locators? Ganun po ba?

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ngayon po, dinidiscuss pa rin po yung magiging commercial contract between BCDA and the U.S. side po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kanina, sinabi nyo, ang usapan dito, whether it's manufacturing or data centers, bring your own electricity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Supply your own water, build your own roads.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kasi, for example, sabi nyo, pwedeng magtayo ng data centers, hindi necessarily sa New Clark City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Una, saan ibang lugar ang tinatarget na pwedeng pagtayuan ng data center?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pangalawa, ano exactly ibig nyo sabihin, bring your own electricity and water, etc.?

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: New Clark City, halimbawa po, dun sa 1,620 hectares na nakikita natin,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: ang usapan po dun ay, sino yung magde-develop, kailangan siya yung mag-provide ng power,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: siya yung mag-build ng roads, at saka yung mag-secure po ng water.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kagaya po na nabanggit ko kanina, pagdating halimbawa sa power,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: tinitignan po natin na pasibilidad na pinag-uusapan ngayon ng BCDA,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: at saka ng mga investors, would be LNG, re-gas, import terminal, and re-gas facilities sa Subic.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Tapos, ipapipe, tapos magtatayo din po sila ng gas-powered plant, dun po embedded doon sa 1,620 hectares.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So, yun pong isang possible, LNG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meron silang sariling exclusively for them.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: It will be under the Department of Energy and ERC regulations.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kaya ko lang po sinasabi ito, kasi possibly ho na exclusive for them.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Pag nagbenta ho sila sa labas, kailangan po nila ng permit.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So, it will be under Philippine laws.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, pwede rin magbenta na labas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: How about water? Ano yung nakikita nyo?

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Dalawa po yung tinatahak pagdating po sa water.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: One is yung nabanggit na rin po ni BCDA President Jake Binkang, yung pong harvesting of the surface water.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kitang-kitaw natin ngayon mga nag-uulan itong past two weeks, yung mga rivers rumaragasa, nasasayang po yung tubig.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So, yung possibility po of having an impounding station to harvest this water.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Yung nakikita po natin would be a desalination facility in Subic, tapos so ipapipe papunta sa Clark.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So, rainwater, parang ganun, isa? Rainwater?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Of course, isang buong ecosystem to, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, pag kinuha't ginamit nila yan, yung tubig na yon hindi necessarily magagamit sa irigasyon or bilang inumin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Of course, it's well known that water used for cooling data centers, eh hindi lang tubig yon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: May mga coal land, may mga kemikal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kaya yun yung isang concern, nagiging madumi yung tubig.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kasama po sa requirement ng BCDA.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kahit tunga limbawa, whether it's a manufacturing facility or...

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kung ano man, would be full compliance with our environmental compliance.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: With our ECC, it's all of the environmental laws.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Kasama na rin po yung water treatment facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nabanggit nyo na hindi lang Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Alam pa yung ibang areas na magkakaroon, posibleng magkaroon, tinatarget na magkaroon ng mga Paxilica-related projects outside of New Clark City?

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Lahat po ng itong mga discussions dito are all based on Philippine internal discussions.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Dahil bago naman kung magkaroon ng Paxilica, bago tayo sumama dun sa statement on the Paxilica, talagang pinopromote na po natin.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Sinasabi natin for the next two and a half years of this administration.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Noon po, ang sinasabi natin, we will be focusing on mining and mineral processing.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Number three, on advanced manufacturing, including on semiconductors and electronics.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: And then number three, on tourism.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ang relevant po dito sa Paxilica are mining and mineral processing, and then yung advanced manufacturing, and then yung digital infrastructure.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So lahat po, may mga internal discussions tayo, tinitignan natin, saan ba pinaka-appropriate sa mga lugar dito sa Pilipinas, yung mga yun.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So for example po, si Department of ICT, meron po siyang ginawa na AI infrastructure roadmap.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So dun po, na-identify niya kung saan yung mga posibling lugar, for example, for data centers, kung saan meron kang tubig, at saka kung saan meron kang power.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So naging controversial recently yung sa Oton, sa Iloilo ba yun?

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Hindi po siya kasama, nor has that investor coordinated with the Board of Investments.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Chair, marami pang mga concerns regarding this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Actually, ang suggestion ko po ay dapat magbigay ng hiwalay at specific briefing ang Department on this Paxilica, kasi nga, napaka-controversyal na usapin, Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay ba yun, Chair? Anong tingin nyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Charisse Anne C. Hernandez
segments.text: We need further discussions. And of course, as Dave mentioned, they're very open naman po with this discussion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Charisse Anne C. Hernandez
segments.text: Now, lipat lang po tayo sa ibang concerns.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Una muna yung kaugnay po sa CARS. Kanina, may nabanggit si Sec na nabayaran na raw yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: You mentioned that. Nabayaran na yung... What were your words?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: We're getting the budget from the DBM for this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Is it the race? Or CARS?

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Yes, Honorable Kong. This is from the CARS program, yung incentives na for Toyota and for Mitsubishi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Ngayon, ang tanong ko, you're getting the budget to DBM when, as far as I know, the appropriations for that,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: originally nasa budget proposal nyo, napunta sa unprogrammed appropriations, and it was vetoed by the President. Tama?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, na-intriga ako sa statement nyo that you are getting the budget from the DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Paano nyo makukuha yung budget when nasa unprogrammed nga, tapos dinito pa?

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Yes, actually, from the DPWH ito. Yusek Perry can explain it further.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa DPWH? Okay, please explain. Intriga ako lalo.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Madam Chair, thank you for the question, Representative Tinio.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So, yung total amount po is 5.1 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Ito po yung utang natin kay Toyota, Mitsubishi, Denso, Manly Plastics, Valery, F-Tech Philippines, SMRC Automotive Technology, Roberts Automotive, tsaka...

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So both the program participants at the model level, so yun pong mga banyaga, pati rin po yung mga local na mga nagsusupply ng mga auto parts.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So ang total amount po ng arirages natin, ang utang natin is 5.156 billion pesos. Tama po kayo na una po meron kaming 125 million pesos yata na nasa budget namin tapos nilagay sa unprogrammed allocation na Vito po.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Tapos ngayon dahil sa kailangan talagang pagkakautang na po natin ito, so kailangan talagang bayaran dahil nag-deliver na po sila ng kanilang mga commitments.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So kukunin po yun, na-identify po. Pwede po kasi mag-identify ka ng savings from other government agencies. Ang nakita po ay may savings po si DPWH. Tapos so yun po yung pagkukuha na ng 5.1 billion pesos. Yung naging savings po nila for 2020-2025.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: 5.1 billion from DPWH 2025, yun ang gagamitin na pambayad sa CARS. So augmentation from savings essentially. Provided may item para doon. Meron bang item para doon?

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Meron pa rin po item na nakalagay doon sa GAAN natin. Meron po kasing meron tayong nakalagay doon na parang maliit lang po na implementation of the CARS program. I think 10 million pesos.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: So may paglalagyan pa rin kung kung baga na bahay. May bahay na tinatawag. May bahay po tayo na paglalagyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Pero ito pala ang nakaka, ngayon ko lang nalaman, savings may 5 billion. Ah, okay.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: Just to correct, Madam Chair, 4.081 billion po pala yun.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Ceferino S. Rodolfo
segments.text: 4.081 billion savings tapos ngayon ipambabayad sa Toyota, sa Mitsubishi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So thank you for that clarification. Magtatanong din tayo sa DBM at sa DPWH regarding this, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Yung third na lang na concern natin with regard to the tariffs imposed by the US, yung 12.5% dahil daw nag, the Philippines imports from countries with forced labor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ang sabi ng DTI, as far as I know, mga 40%, up to 40% ng Philippine exports affected dito. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Could you elaborate? Bakit tayo, akala ko ba magkaibigan ang Pilipinas at US pero pinatawan ng 12.5%? Yung Malaysia, Indonesia, parang 10% lang yata? Diba? Tayo 12 pa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 12.5. Please explain the consequences, anong epekto sa mga exporters natin? Sino-sino ang mga ito at anong ginagawa nyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dahil syempre, dihado, magiging mas mahal ang mga produktong Pilipino in highly competitive export markets.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: Yes, actually, Kong, for the exporters, we also try to find, in case may problem sila pagpasok ng goods sa US, we find other markets for them.

segments.speaker: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque
segments.text: We have different foreign trade attachés globally. So, nakakahanap po kami ng market para sa kanila and also locally. I'll forward you, Kong, Honorable Kong, to the trade negotiator, to our chief negotiator to discuss yung 12.5%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano ba na-explain nyo? Bakit, ano yung sabihin nito? Like, my understanding, mainly this is...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: meant to penalize countries that import from China, among others. Diba ganun? O, huwag na tayo maglokohan. Yun yun eh. Sige, please.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: Thank you, ma'am, and good afternoon, Your Honors. Number one, with respect to the imposition of tariffs by the United States, I think in terms of context, Po, Your Honor, we have to understand that when President Trump,

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: assumed office, the policy of the United States has been to impose unilateral tariffs. So, basically, the direction is really for them to hit countries wherein they have deficit. But, of course, the first unilateral tariffs was declared unconstitutional by the US Supreme Court, and so they resorted again to another basis by which they can impose unilateral tariffs.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: After that, they imposed Section 122 tariffs, which can only last for 150 days.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: And then, after the expiration of Section 1 to 2, now they initiated the investigation under Section 301, and that's the basis by which they have imposed the 12.5% tariffs for, I think, 67 countries, including the Philippines, and for, I think, only around 10 countries, 10%.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: Now, the basis of Section 301 tariffs under the Trade Regulation Act of the United States, Your Honor, is actually...

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: premise on the fact that countries or economies trading with the United States has no law that bans or prohibits the importation of goods which are made or results of forced labor.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: So, that's the basis. So, in other words, it doesn't mean that a particular country or economy has a weak regime when it comes to combating, for example, forced labor.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: So, in the case of the Philippines, we issued a joint administrative order institutionalizing the mechanism by which we can address that particular concern of the United States.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: And the same is under evaluation now of the US for purposes of at least compliance to their Section 301 investigation.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: So, iyon po ngayon iyong status ngayon.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: In fact, itong recent issuance po ng JAO, under evaluation.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: But we have highlighted the fact that the Philippines has a strong legal regime as far as addressing forced labor from the Constitution, laws, rules and regulations, among others po.

segments.speaker: DTI Undersecretary Allan B. Gepty
segments.text: So, yan po yung naging basihan po nun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, Chair, just to tatapusin natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Charisse Anne C. Hernandez
segments.text: Wind down po with your question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, una, kailangan magpasa natin tayo ng bagong batas para...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: lift, maalis tayo sa listahan, parang ganun ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pangalawa, meron ba tayong kakayahan para ma-determine whether or not imports into the Philippines were produced with forced labor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At pangatlo, pwede po bang mabigyan tayo ng listahan ng mga apektadong industriya?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung sinabi ni yung Secretary na meron ng mga hindi na maka-import sa US, kaya tutulungan daw ng DTI, humanap ng ibang markets.

segments.text: Kasi may mga exemptions din, di ba?

segments.text: Yung mga automotive, I think semiconductors, ganun, hindi sinama eh, di ba?

segments.text: My understanding, it's like garments and so on.

segments.text: Para malaman natin, sino yung mga natamaan na...

segments.text: Yes, Honorable Kong, I'll forward you to EMB, Bianca, Export Marketing Bureau.

segments.text: So, hawak nila yung mga exporters po that export globally.

DTI Export Marketing Bureau official Bianca (functional attribution)
segments.text: For the tariff does not cover products, certain raw materials and products needed by US industries,

segments.speaker: DTI Export Marketing Bureau official Bianca (functional attribution)
segments.text: and products that the US cannot produce or source.

segments.speaker: DTI Export Marketing Bureau official Bianca (functional attribution)

segments.text: So, the 12.5% only covers 30% of our total exports to the US.

segments.speaker: DTI Export Marketing Bureau official Bianca (functional attribution)
segments.text: So, in terms of the sectors affected, it would cover electrical, machinery, and equipment.

segments.text: Some labor-intensive industries, including leather, travel goods, apparel, footwear, toys.
